items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Says he could play through knee injury
items.body_text: Chase (knee) said he could play in a game Wednesday after exiting Tuesday's practice early, Kelsey Conway of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Downplays knee injury
items.body_text: Chase downplayed his knee injury Tuesday, saying it was a "little hyperextension," and he could've kept practicing, Kelsey Conway of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Olave: Exits practice early Tuesday
items.body_text: Olave exited Tuesday's practice early with an undisclosed injury, Mike Triplett of New Orleans.Football reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Practicing Tuesday
items.body_text: LaPorta (hip) returned to practice Tuesday, Richard Silva of The Detroit News reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Limps off field at Tuesday's practice
items.body_text: Chase (knee) limped off the field at Tuesday's practice after landing awkwardly while attempting to reel in a deep ball, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
